sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that a competent Food Safety Appellate Tribunal has been duly constituted under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The matter was presented before this Court because non-constitution of such Tribunal.
Therefore, the present matter is transferred to the Presiding Officer of the said Tribunal for adjudication.
Registry to take follow up actions as per law.
Petitioner is directed to remain present in the said (2 of 2) [CRLW-138/2015] Tribunal on 28th August, 2017.
The matter is disposed of from this Court.

(VIJAY KUMAR VYAS),J.
